O1.citation: “Run a fresh blind re-evaluation of all three cases—A, B, and C.”

O2.citation: The artifact specifies “one context-free runner per case” and says “Judges assessed each artifact,” but does not require a fresh runner for every repeated trial; repeated trials are not specified.

O3.citation: Evidence is missing: the artifact requires only one runner per case and gives no repetition count or per-case pass rates.

O4.citation: Evidence is missing: the artifact does not require diagnosing a new miss as a skill defect versus a bad case, followed by another revision and full-suite rerun.

O5.citation: “Only then can you report before/after movement: previously A/C passed and B failed for a named defect; after the edit, A/B/C all pass, with B’s defect resolved and no regression in A or C.”

S1.citation: Smell absent: it explicitly reruns “all three cases—A, B, and C,” not only B.

S2.citation: Smell absent: it requires “one context-free runner per case” and says runners saw “only their case inputs, never the expected outcomes or prior artifacts.”

S3.citation: Smell absent: runners produce artifacts while separately identified “Judges assessed each artifact against its bar and the skill’s first principles.”

S4.citation: Smell absent: although pass rates are missing, the artifact does not report only an aggregate score; it requires individual A, B, and C outcomes.

S5.citation: Smell absent: success is conditioned on “A and C still pass” and “no regression in A or C.”

rationale: The artifact correctly mandates a full A/B/C regression sweep with blind, case-isolated runners, evidence-based judging, and legible per-case before/after outcomes. It does not repeat important cases enough to calculate pass rates, guarantee fresh runners for each repetition, or prescribe the diagnose–revise–full-sweep loop when a new miss appears. Therefore the fix cannot yet be declared reliably validated.
